items.title: Two critical PHP flaws affecting Magento, WooCommerce and other eCommerce platforms
items.summary: Two critical security holes in PHP, the underlying software for Magento, that could lead to attacks if the server's PHP is not updated.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce | APSB26-153
items.summary: This update addresses vulnerabilities rated critical, high, and medium that could result in arbitrary code execution, privilege escalation, arbitrary file system write, and security feature bypass. Adobe is not aware of any exploits in the wild for issues addressed in this update (excluding CVE-2026-75650 which needs a separate hotfix).

items.title: BlockStrap: Magento and Adobe Commerce RCE
items.summary: A critical vulnerability allowing unauthenticated attackers to achieve remote code execution, fixed as part of APSB26-153.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce | APSB26-146
items.summary: This update resolves a critical vulnerability (CVE-2026-75650) that could result in arbitrary code execution, and Adobe is aware of it being exploited in the wild.

items.title: StyleSmuggler: Unauthenticated Remote Code Execution
items.summary: An Improper Neutralization of Special Elements Used in a Template Engine vulnerability leading to unauthenticated remote code execution, actively exploited in the wild.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce | APSB26-92
items.summary: This update resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities, including an unauthenticated incorrect authorization flaw (CVE-2026-71362) that could lead to security feature bypass, arbitrary code execution, and privilege escalation.

items.title: Unauthenticated Incorrect Authorization / Customer Account Takeover
items.summary: An unauthenticated incorrect authorization flaw that could lead to customer account takeover, security feature bypass, and privilege escalation without requiring an existing account or user interaction.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce | APSB26-73
items.summary: This update resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities that could lead to arbitrary code execution, privilege escalation, and security feature bypass.

items.title: Arbitrary Code Execution via Webhooks
items.summary: This vulnerability affects webhooks and could lead to arbitrary code execution, requiring authentication and admin privileges for exploitation, and was addressed in APSB26-73.

items.title: PolyShell: Unrestricted File Upload via REST API
items.summary: A critical flaw in Magento's REST API that allows unauthenticated attackers to upload executable files, with widespread exploitation attempts observed since March 2026.
